hypotheses.claim: In attribute_effect, the is_select effect unconditionally calls select_option(select, prev.value); with no value in the spread, prev.value is undefined, so select_option sets selectedIndex=-1, clearing the DOM-selected option.
hypotheses.prediction: Guarding the effect to run only when 'value' in prev makes the spread select keep its selected option; test passes.
hypotheses.falsifier: If the failure persists, the clearing happens elsewhere (e.g., set_attributes) and the guard won't help.

hypotheses.claim: The bug comes from set_attributes normalizing/removing attributes on the select (e.g. value setter) rather than the trailing is_select effect.
hypotheses.prediction: The spread's set_attributes path touches 'value' or select internals even without a value key.
hypotheses.falsifier: Compiled output shows the spread only contains onclick; set_attributes never touches select value, so this is unlikely.
